# Greenfield PRD Fixture

## Product Goal

Create a PRD-only architecture package for a lightweight approval workflow before implementation planning starts.

## Requirements

| Requirement ID | Status | Requirement | Success Metric |
|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-001 | Accepted | Users can submit an approval request with title, amount, and justification. | request submission contract test passes |
| REQ-002 | Accepted | Reviewers can approve or reject a pending request with an audit note. | reviewer decision contract test passes |
| REQ-003 | Rejected | Build Brownfield repository migration evidence. | out of scope for greenfield PRD mode |
